acks.description: Enter acknowledgement: a new session generation is created and its lease is active.
acks.name: ack_entered

acks.description: Leave acknowledgement: the session is closed and session_active=false.
acks.name: ack_closed

core.detail: seq 11 predates the live enter at seq 12

acks.description: Late leave acknowledgement: SUPERSEDED; the newer sess-demo-0002 remains session_active=true and is not closed by the old logout.
acks.name: ack_superseded

acks.description: Cross-installation conflict: REJECTED with EXECUTOR_BUSY; do not expose or preempt the holder session.
acks.name: ack_rejected_busy

acks.description: Status acknowledgement: REPORTED with a session snapshot.
acks.name: ack_status_reported

acks.description: Presence boundary: explicitly empty SessionInfo encodes as tag plus zero length (7200). TypeScript decode and canonicalization must retain empty-message presence even when every nested scalar is default.
acks.name: ack_empty_status_presence

requests.description: Initial enter: omit expected_house_revision=0 and empty target_session_id; fields 10/11 emit no bytes.
requests.name: enter_minimal

requests.description: Leave without a session ID; late leave has the same shape because its operation watermark defines the scope.
requests.name: leave_minimal

requests.description: Leave with a known session ID.
requests.name: leave_with_session

requests.description: Status query does not advance op_seq; includes the latest local sequence for reference.
requests.name: status_minimal

requests.description: Explicit-default boundary: expected_house_revision=0 and empty target_session_id are present in the input, but canonical bytes must match enter_minimal exactly through TypeScript default stripping and prost elision.
requests.name: default_boundaries

requests.description: 64-bit precision boundary: op_seq=2^60 exceeds 2^53. TypeScript must preserve Long values from decode/fromObject without a Number round-trip; both languages produce identical canonical bytes.
requests.name: enter_big_op_seq

requests.description: Actor differs from signer: the signature verifies, but popclaw_id does not equal base58(signer_pubkey); identity binding must fail with AUTH_INVALID.
requests.name: signer_mismatch_rejected

sequences.description: Two logins around a delayed logout, in server delivery order. LEAVE(11) is generated locally but not delivered. ENTER(12) performs same-installation generation rotation: close the old session, increment the fence and create a new session. LEAVE(11) then arrives for the first time: entered_op_seq=12 exceeds 11, so it is SUPERSEDED and session_active=true throughout. Old logout never closes the newer generation.
sequences.name: enter_rotated_enter_late_leave

steps.note: op_seq exceeds the old entered_op_seq=10: generation rotation returns ENTERED, not ALREADY_ENTERED reuse.
Generated earlier but delivered to the server for the first time now; record the watermark without changing the newer generation.

sequences.description: Enter retry at the same op_seq: the same installation and generation return ALREADY_ENTERED, reuse the session and refresh the lease without rotation or a fence increase.
sequences.name: enter_retry_same_seq_already_entered

steps.note: Idempotent replay of the same request_id; refresh signing times and nonce without changing semantic contents.

sequences.description: Re-enter after committed leave, followed by an old retry: LEAVE(11) commits CLOSED; ENTER(12) creates a new generation; replaying LEAVE(11) returns ALREADY_CLOSED, settles only its old outbox row and preserves the newer session.
sequences.name: enter_leave_enter_leave_retry

steps.note: New generation after a completed leave.
Retry of an already decided request: replay its stored outcome with no new side effects.

sequences.description: Logout before unacknowledged enter: leave(11) arrives first, records a disabled-through=11 tombstone even without a session and returns session_active=false. A late enter(10) is rejected by the watermark, leaving no orphan session.
sequences.name: leave_before_enter_commit

sequences.description: Leave commits but its ACK is lost. Retrying the same request_id returns ALREADY_CLOSED with no second effect. After re-entry, an old ACK settles only its original outbox row and preserves new state.
sequences.name: leave_ack_lost_retry

steps.note: ACK lost in transit after server commit.
Refresh signing times and nonce while preserving semantic request_id.

sequences.description: Concurrent login across installations: one executor per house and identity; the later requester receives REJECTED with EXECUTOR_BUSY, without preemption or background takeover polling. Generation rotation applies only within one installation.
sequences.name: cross_installation_busy

sequences.description: Renew of a fenced generation cannot substitute for enter: reject with SESSION_FENCED and never revive the old session.
sequences.name: renew_after_fence_rejected

steps.note: target_session_id=sess-demo-0001 identifies the fenced old generation.

sequences.description: Status requires signature authentication before returning a REPORTED snapshot. Unsigned probes are rejected at HTTP level without a signed acknowledgement; they are outside these sequence steps and require an HTTP 401 integration check.
sequences.name: status_authenticated_report
